shortDescription: A framework for magical "entad" items: randomly rolled, rarity-scaled traits on weapons, apparel and furniture that reveal themselves through use, can be bound to a pawn's bloodline, and give durability, moods, abilities, damage effects and building bonuses.
body:
## Binding (EntadBinding.cs)
- An entad can be bound to one or more pawns (`CompEntad.Bind`, `EntadApi.Bind/Unbind/GetBoundPawns/TraitsActiveFor`, dev actions "Bind Entad to pawn" / "Unbind Entad"). Unbound = traits work for everyone.
- Bound items work as ordinary items for anyone; traits only work and reveal for bound pawns and their descendants (Parent relations, BFS depth 16, cached per pawn per item).
- Gated per user: wearer stats, held-item stats, damage and weapon effects, abilities, equipped hediffs, equipped/furniture moods, triggers, meals, reveals, furniture abilities, reloading. Always on: durability, market value, building properties, unheld items, turret guns.
- `bindOnFirstUse`: first player-faction pawn to equip or use it for themselves (never during generation, never a corpse).
- WorldPawnGC keeps bound pawns and their descendants. Discarded pawns filtered on save.
- UI: inspect "Bound to" (full names), info card row (red when holder is outside the bloodline; damage rows hidden for them), traits tooltip note, alert "Entad bound to another bloodline" for colonists and slaves incl. caravans.

## Triggers (EntadTriggers.cs)
- `triggers` list on a trait: "when X happens, do Y". Events for worn/wielded gear: Kill, WakeUp, BillDone, JobDone (with `jobs`), TakeDamage, Downed, Eat. Furniture: Use, filtered by `use` flags Sleep / Eat / Work / Recreation / Other. A trait can't mix the two; `UseKindsOf` keeps a Use trigger off furniture that can never report its kind.
- Effects: `thought` (plain memory; from furniture it renews per building instead of stacking), `hediff` (+ `hediffHours`, needs a Disappears comp; repeats top the time up), `heal` (HP, worst non-permanent injuries first), `rest` / `food` / `joy` (fraction of the need). Amounts are rolled per item and scale with rarity (needs capped at 100%); `chance` and `cooldownHours` (per item) don't.
- Hooks: RecordsUtility.Notify_PawnKilled postfix (Kill, any held gear), Pawn.PostApplyDamage postfix, Pawn_HealthTracker.MakeDowned prefix (before the weapon drops; anaesthetic skipped), Bill_Production.Notify_IterationCompleted postfix, and the existing CleanupCurrentJob prefix (WakeUp = LayDown of 1h+ in which the pawn slept per Need_Rest.lastRestTick and isn't downed; Eat = finished nourishing Ingest; JobDone; furniture Use kinds). Each hook checks a per-event "any trait uses this" flag first. Gear triggers work for any holder the item is active for, raiders included.
- Chance and cooldown settle when the event happens; effects run next tick from the EntadTriggerQueue GameComponent (not saved), outside vanilla's damage/downing code.
- Reveal kind `Trigger`, first time one fires. Card line e.g. "On being downed: heals 34 HP (at most once every 24 hours)".
- `killThought` is shorthand for a Kill trigger with that thought (converted in ResolveReferences; still weapon-only).
- Traits: Last Stand (Rare, scales: downed → heal 30~40, 24h cooldown), Mending Rest (Uncommon furniture, scales: after sleeping here → heal 6~10).

## Weapon effects (EntadWeaponTraits.cs, stage 1)
- `weaponProperties` (rolled, rarity-scaled): BurstShotCount factor (round up), BurstShotSpeed factor, StoppingPower offset. Burst properties only on weapons that already burst; stopping power only on projectile weapons. Rarity cap x3 / +3.
- Info card: vanilla Burst shot count, Burst fire rate and Stopping power rows rewritten (ThingDef.SpecialDisplayStats postfix, primary verb) with the same rounding as the Verb getters, vanilla unique-weapon traits folded in first, and an "Entad traits" tooltip section. Only revealed traits count on the card.
- `ignoreAccuracyMaluses`, `equippedHediffs` (Clarity: +5% consciousness, +10% learning), `partialStats`.
- Weapon properties and accuracy reveal with the Damage kind (when a shot lands).
- Traits: Rapid Volley, Quickfire, Impact Rounds, Stormsight, Battle Joy (Kill trigger via killThought), Clarity.

## Reloadable abilities (EntadReload.cs)
- `abilityAmmo`, `abilityAmmoPerCharge`, `abilityReloadTicks`; weapons and apparel only. AbilityDef copy has no cooldown, so only reloading adds charges.
- Charges on the pawn's Ability while equipped, on the trait otherwise (always written back on revoke). One slot per AbilityDef per pawn.
- `Entad_Reload` job + driver, right-click-ammo float menu provider, JobGiver_Reload postfix (allocation-free gear pre-check). Example: Stun Charge.

## Durability
- MaxHitPoints × `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]` (defaults 1.25/1.5/2/3/5). Never hidden.

## Furniture mood and abilities
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`: work/recreation/own use at chairs, beds, eating tables; a sleep cut short (raid, draft) now credits the bed too. `Thought_EntadFurniture` keyed by thingIDNumber; longer expiry wins at the stack cap.
- Furniture abilities run through the `Entad_UseFurnitureAbility` job.

## Random mood traits
- `MoodCandidates`: single visible-stage plain memories from all mods, no requirements, no chains or placeholders.

## Localization
- All player text keyed `EF_`. Debug actions and logs stay English.

## Settings
- Tabs General / Rarity and durability / Traits; trait list shows rarity or "Variable", summary lists trigger events; search covers trigger events and effects.

## Save compatibility
- Removed traits map through `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`. Renamed trait → full re-roll; a value list that changed length (incl. triggers) → only that list re-rolls.

## Planned
- Stage 2: Persona trait (vanilla bondedWeapon slot and equip lock, bonded hediffs/thoughts, Jealous, patch ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitBonded).
- Stage 3: an EntadTraitDef per WeaponTraitDef.
- Stage 4: intercept unique/persona weapon creation and make plain-def entads; settings default on, DLC-gated, "exactly like vanilla" sub-setting.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Lineage cache isn't invalidated if a mod adds parent relations mid-game.
- Kill triggers also fire on slaughter and hunting kills (Battle Joy stacks for hunters).
- A same-length retune of a trait's value lists keeps old rolls under the new meaning.
- Circinus palette pins: the last pinned entry fails (launcher side); pad the list with a throwaway entry.
